notes.title: 50% OFF & Updates
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30720159/c339eb137cb23936c8a36051ccf4768593710bae.png[/img]

Hello, guys. The new Mina Game is under development. Thank you very much for all of your support so that I can continue developing the new game.
I'll do my best to whip something out ASAP, thanks again :D

Update Log:
1. Huuma Mina Ninja Costume added.
2. Story Mode Extreme Difficulty added.
3. some bug fixes and improvements.

アップデート：
１．コスチューム追加：風魔くノ一
２．ストーリーモード難易度追加：地獄
３．不具合修正と機能改善

更新：
1. 追加服裝：風魔女忍者
2. 故事模式難易度追加：究極
3. Bug修正並提升效能

notes.title: Recent updates
notes.notes:
1. dialogue speed increased.
2. some text improvement including textures which have text written on them.
3. key bindings for camera rotation (horz): r, q, numpad 4, numpad 6.
4. key bindings for camera rotation (vert): pageup, pagedown, numpad 2, numpad 8
5. key bindings for camera zoom in/out: home, end, numpad -, numpad +
6. some bug fixes.

notes.title: Prepare your controller.
notes.notes:
Cinderella Escape 2 Revenge is an Action Game. Therefore, a controller is strongly recommended. The default key-mapping is for XBox controller. However, if you have a PS4 controller, please follow the Guide to set proper key-mapping.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1158754049
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1158803618
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1158811049
